scripts.dev: npm --workspace shared run build && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --workspace server run dev" "node ./client/scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.dev:server: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run dev
scripts.dev:client: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace client run dev
scripts.build: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace shared run test && npm --workspace server run test && npm --workspace client run test
scripts.x:login: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run x:login
scripts.x:verify: npm --workspace shared run build && npm --workspace server run x:verify
